The '''Fossil Island Volcano''' (marked '''Volcano''' on the [[world map]]) is a volcanic outcrop found on the eastern coast of [[Fossil Island]]. Periodically, there are [[volcanic eruption]]s shooting balls of lava out of the volcano. If one hits a player, it can inflict minor damage.

The entrance to the [[Volcanic Mine]] can be found here. In addition, there are also many [[ash pile]]s found throughout the volcano, which can be mined for [[soda ash]] and [[volcanic ash]].

Near the volcano, the [[Fossil Island mine]] and the [[Verdant Valley]] can be found.
